info.title: BrainSAIT Clinical Copilot API
info.description: Talk to the grounded Saudi/Gulf clinical copilot (real Workers-AI LLM + medical Vectorize RAG + live provider Registry SPID/OID/verification context) under a strict clinical-safety constitution. Routes any clinical / CDI / coding / DRG / NPHIES claims / provider-verification / patient question. Auto-senses the audience (doctor | cdi | rcm | patient) and mirrors Arabic/English. Returns a plain-text answer; flag emergencies to 997/911.

post.summary: Ask the grounded clinical copilot a question
post.description: Sends one turn (plus optional prior turns) to the grounded clinical copilot. Returns the assistant's plain-text answer and metadata.

messages.description: Recent conversation. The last item is the current user question. Include earlier turns (up to ~8) for context.

lang.description: Preferred reply language. Omit to auto-detect from the question text. 'ar' for Arabic.

mode.description: Optional explicit mode override. Omit to auto-detect. doctor=concise technical clinician aid; cdi=documentation/coding/audit; rcm=claims/NPHIES/denials; patient=plain, calm, safety-first; general=registry/identity/platform questions.

response.description: The copilot's plain-text answer (may contain simple markdown).

mode.description: The audience mode actually used for this answer.

safetyFlag.description: True if emergency/red-flag terminology was detected; the answer then includes a 997/911 care directive.

grounded.description: True when the answer was grounded in retrieved registry/medical context.

used.description: 'ai' means the real model answered; 'fallback' means the engine was temporarily unavailable and a short notice was returned.
